scope: GSC-only (Search Console rank/impression/click data from keywords-master.json's 83 tracked keywords). Competitor #1-blocker and AI-visibility sections remain manual/out of scope.

needs_attention: Keyword coverage: 22 of 83 tracked KEYWORDS show any GSC impressions in this aggregate window (up from 21 last run); 61 tracked keywords show none. This is a keyword count, not a page count — many tracked keywords share a small set of target pages. Per keywords-master.json, only 1 of 51 distinct target pages in the tracker still points at a staging URL (see priority actions); the rest already point to live www URLs, so this is not primarily a tracker-hygiene issue right now.

Most-slipped term: "bariatric psychological evaluation near me" fell from position 45.2 to 79.8 (delta -34.6, 5 impressions). "Weight loss therapist" also dropped sharply (5.5 to 32.0, delta -26.5) but on only 1 impression, so treat as directional only. Caveat: positions built from single-digit impression counts swing day to day and are directional, not a confirmed ranking loss.

Distribution shift since 9/24: tracked keywords in the #2-3 tier dropped from 4 to 2 ("bariatric therapist" slipped from ~2.0 to 3.9, tier #4-10), while the 21+ tier grew from 7 to 9 keywords — worth a quick check that nothing changed on-page for the newly-slipped terms.

summary: Bariatric counseling and bariatric surgery counseling continue to hold #2-3, and impression-weighted average position improved from ~14.9 in May to 10.8 today with a sharp gain in the last 4 days. But clicks remain almost flat (7 off 2,069 impressions today) and keyword coverage is essentially unchanged at roughly a quarter of the 83 tracked terms showing any impressions — the priority is converting existing visibility into clicks, not chasing more coverage.
